 • Collect scrap metal (copper wiring, aluminum siding, steel appliances) and take it to a local scrapyard—rates range from $0.20 to $1.50+ per pound, depending on material.

5. House-Sitting and Property Caretaking  
 • Watch sites like TrustedHousesitters or Nomador for people leaving their homes vacant.  In exchange for basic upkeep, security checks or pet care, you get free lodging—sometimes for weeks or months.

 • Caution: It’s highly technical, network fees can eat your profits, and any coding mistake will cost you the entire loan.

• Always read contracts and fine print—high fees or interest can turn $500 today into $800 owed tomorrow.
